name: comp-322

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the dialog with a typed message and the Send feedback button in place.

tagline: Feedback popup pairs a big message box with links to docs and Discord.
summary: A trigger opens a dark dialog with a short intro linking to tutorials, documentation and Discord, a large feedback textarea, and a white Send feedback button.
appearance: Closed, an outlined Feedback button. Open, a dark rounded dialog with a left-aligned bold heading, a grey line carrying three underlined inline links, a tall outlined textarea spanning the width, and a white Send feedback button aligned right.
behaviour: The trigger fades the dialog in over a dimmed page; typing fills the textarea and the demo supplies a sample message. Send feedback does nothing, and the X or Escape closes it.
demo_content: Placeholder asks how to improve coss.com; an example message reads Love the new command palette!
search_phrases: tell us what you think modal
use_when: You want to collect free-form feedback without sending users to a separate page.
avoid_when: There is no submit logic or success state, and the help links are placeholders that go nowhere.
customise: Title, description, link labels and placeholder are hardcoded; only the message text is user input.
weight_why: One dialog and a textarea; no animation beyond the opening fade.

a11y.note: The textarea is labelled for screen readers, but the help links open nothing and no success or error is announced.

issues: Send feedback has no handler, so the message is never submitted.
The tutorials, documentation and Discord links are dead placeholders.
polish_why: Clean dialog with a generous text area; stock styling and inert actions.
